args.title: Add API reference details about limits on report fields
args.body:
File: src/api/reports.ts

Add explicit listing of the limits on report fields such as the number of recipients, length of the report name, and maximum categories count in the API documentation or validation schema comments, so clients can check these limits before sending requests.

label: feature
file: src/api/reports.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

This issue requests that the API reference include explicit limits on report fields like recipients count, report name length, and category list length, which are currently enforced in the code but undocumented. The file src/api/reports.ts is responsible as it defines these limits and validation schemas. A draft pull request is opened to add this documentation to help clients validate inputs properly before sending requests.
